data: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · TypeScript, React, Node.js

Full-stack engineer with 14 years of experience building web products in e-commerce, fintech, SaaS and, most recently, aviation. I've led four teams, covering architecture, code standards and mentoring, and I contribute to CI/CD and infrastructure.
I work mostly with TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js, and I use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) every day. Based in Košice, Slovakia, and open to remote roles in EU time zones or hybrid work locally.
